column1: # Once City's things (phiphx geom::thing), a row each part: the thing,
# the part, its form, its size (metres along x, y, z; a thing's: times
# its own), where its middle stands (y up; a thing faces +z, an animal
# walking +x), its turn (degrees about x, then y, then z), how round
# (a share of its smallest side; a letter's of its height; a bloom's of
# thing's: the looks it swaps, from=to), what it is made from (a
# letter: source:letter; an outline: a source; a thing: its name) and
# how often it repeats (copies, then each copy's step: moved x y z,
# then turned x y z about the thing's middle). - for none.
# A couch's body: what lies between its two side panels. Seats are
# 0.46 high on the top of their cushion; each seat 0.62 wide.
# The couches: each a letter of Phi-Pill Bold as its two side panels,
# 0.12 thick, seen from the side (the letter's left at the back), and a
# Four more made of a letter whole: the pill of an I lying down, as long
# as the letter is high; the o lying flat, a ring to sit on; the m's two
# arches under a cushion; and the bird, Phiogy's p, as the side panels
# of the rose chaise of the lounge.
# The lioness, sitting as a gate's guardian does, facing +z: built of
# Amber, the gate's lioness, wears the lioness's own looks; Onyx is
# black and gold; Jade is the lounge's green lion.
# The zebra, walking +x: its neck and legs are things of their own, each
# Zebras of the city's colours: each the zebra, its white and its black
# The trees: sixteen kinds, of pills, balls, cones and rings, and of the
# font's letters (the Y, the T, the S and the f as trunks) and the bird.
# The gate: ONCE in Phi-Pill Bold, 5.5 high and gold, on two plinths
# with the way in between them; each letter's counter a door 1.1 wide
# and 3.4 high. Amber and Onyx sit either side of the way in, outside.
# The lotus dome: a bowl under its floor, two rings of petals, gold ribs
# meeting in a crown; the lounge inside it (the bird chaise, the red
# chairs, the pouf, the stool, and Jade).
# A lamp of the way in: the i of Phi-Pill, its dot the light.
# The floating city's own pieces, as the Floating City drawings of
# Front_View, FLOWER-BUILDING) and the purple render of 24 November
# 2026 have them: a petal dome of gold ribs and glowing lattice over the
# middle; cake towers of scalloped tiers with an orb on top; bubble
# domes; houses of clover tiers; blob pads with glowing rims; tubes of
# glass for bridges; a wavy ring round it all; gliders in the air.
# The ring's pads, each with what stands on it.
# The craft, each going +x (a rocket stands up +y). Their windows and
# lights are letters of Phiber, whose o is a rounded square; their boxes
# are rounded by Phiber's corner (0.05 of a letter's height, so 0.05 of
# Jetskis: a hull raised from the user's red sketches (hull-long.svg,
# hull-short.svg), white; the same outline narrower and higher for the
# blue deck; a yellow stripe, a black seat, the console, the bars, a
# jet; Phiber o's for its lights. As the jetski of the photo of 24
# Eight jetskis: the two hulls in four liveries each, the photo's blue
# The Phijet: a pill of a body, swept wings and a T tail, engines on the
# tail, a row of Phiber o's for windows each side.
# Four Phijets, small to large: the light jet, the jet, the large jet
# with engines under its wings too, and the liner with two more.
# The rockets, as Starship is built: a can of steel, an ogive nose,
# flaps, bells under it; Phiber o's for its windows.
# Four rockets: the hopper, the ship, the full stack, and the ship for
# Mars and beyond, white and gold, on six legs, its sun wings open.
# The sixteen lands, from ice to the tropics, each a round tile 40 m
# across in the manner of the user's pictures of 24 November 2026 (soft
# hills one behind another, a ring of river), coloured bright as a
# theme park's: glacier, ice field, tundra, snow pines, alpine lake,
# taiga, misty hills, meadow, vineyard ring, lavender, canyon, dunes,
# savanna, oasis, rainforest, a tropic island; their trees are the
# city's. `lands` lays them out four by four, ice at one corner, the
# The lotus dome in lilac and sky, and in mint and jade.
# Once City: the floating island over a sea of cloud, its plaza, the
# way in through the gate between lamps, the lotus dome in its middle
# and three small domes behind it, the sixteen trees twice round the
# plaza (the outer ring from 30 degrees off the way in, every 20; the
# inner from 40, the other way round), the sixteen couches round the
# dome facing it, and the zebras about the way in; over the middle the
# petal dome, round the island a wavy ring of six pads (towers, bubble
# domes, clover houses) each with a tube of glass across to it, and
# gliders in the air. The island and its plaza are scalloped, eight
# lobes round, as the drawings' middle is.
